intro: When your space needs more than a bed, Glory steps up. With soft LED lighting, display shelves, and smart storage, it helps you stay organised without losing the luxe.

features.title: Lighting that feels just right
features.text: The built-in LED light with a dimmer lets you adjust the glow to suit your mood — cosy and calm or bright and clear, all at your fingertips.

features.title: Essentials at home on your headboard
features.text: With its ledge-style shelf, your headboard becomes a practical hub for all your favourites — from a good book to your evening tea.

features.title: Organised storage, made easy
features.text: The underbed compartments offer divided storage that’s perfect for keeping things tidy — no rummaging, just simple organisation at your pace. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Comfort you can truly relax into
features.text: Our cushioned headboard offers soft, reliable support whether you’re settling in with a book or easing into your morning routine.

features.title: Tall, striking, and made to support
features.text: The grand height of our headboard brings elegance to your space while giving you full back support — turning your bed into a daily retreat.

name: Upmods Glory Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
